recentItems.title: Kampo ni Duterte kinumpirmang gumamit ng mga alias para sa mga nakatanggap ng confidentials funds
recentItems.description:
Mga alyas at hindi tunay na pangalan ang ilan sa mga nakalistang nakatanggap ng confidential funds ni Vice President Sara Duterte.

Iyan ang kinumpirma ng kampo ng bise matapos tumestigo ang isang opisyal ng Philippine Statistics Authority na bukod sa mga kakaibang pangalan gaya ni Timon Pusa na wala sa kanilang records… may mga sanggol at mga taong matagal nang yumao na nasa listahan. 

Hatid ni senior correspondent Eimor Santos ang recap ng Day 22 ng impeachment trial, live mula Senado.

recentItems.title: 'Mary Grace Piattos' hindi na ipatatawag ng prosekusyon | NewsWatch Reports
recentItems.description:
Hindi na ipatatawag ng prosekusyon ang tinaguriang “Mary Grace Piattos” bilang witness sa paglilitis ni Vice President Sara Duterte.

Kasabay ‘yan ng pagtestigo ni Assistant National Statistician Marizza Grande – na wala silang records ng sinabing tumanggap ng confidential funds ng bise.

‘Yan at ang iba pang highlights sa trial, hatid ni Lance Mejico sa panayam kay prosecution counsel and spokesperson Jay Tolosa.

recentItems.title: Claire Castro | The Newsmaker
recentItems.description:
President Bongbong Marcos is pushing for a more comprehensive flood control plan as his administration deals with corruption issues and questions over billions spent on projects nationwide.

Meanwhile, former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan could potentially turn state witness. And why does the Palace appear to be repeatedly focusing on flooding in Davao, a Duterte stronghold?

Today's newsmaker: Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro

recentItems.title: Duterte faces arrest over grave threats | The Newsmaker
recentItems.description:
The Quezon City Regional Trial Court has issued a warrant of arrest against Vice President Sara Duterte, according to a statement from her camp.

The statement said Duterte has no intention of evading the law and will continue to pursue all available legal remedies.

Today’s Newsmaker, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro. Usec. Claire.

recentItems.description: A beloved specialty from Cavite, tinapa is enjoyed far and wide across the Philippines, cherished for its distinct smoky aroma and rich, savory flavor. Discover more about this delicacy in this episode of Culinary Chronicles.

recentItems.title: Marcos: National flood control masterplan hindi naipapatupad | NewsWatch Reports
recentItems.description:
May flood control masterplan ba o wala? Inamin ni Pangulong Bongbong Marcos na dekada na ang binilang at hindi pa rin naipapatupad ang isang flood control masterplan sa bansa.

Ayon sa pangulo, pinasisimulan na niya ang pagbuo ng isang plano kontra baha.

Ang report mula Malacañang, hatid ni Tristan Nodalo.

recentItems.title: Duterte impeachment: Poa dumepensa sa aksyon kaugnay ng confidential funds | NewsWatch Reports
recentItems.description:
“Abogadong walang alam.” 

Iyan ang tahasang tawag ng prosekusyon kay defense lawyer Michael Poa na tumestigo sa impeachment trial kaugnay ng confidential funds ng Department of Education bilang dating spokesperson at chief of staff nang si Vice President Sara Duterte ang kalihim nito.

Ang detalye sa Day 21 ng impeachment trial, alamin sa report nina Eimor Santos at Lance Mejico mula Senado.
